clue.text: Soaring sprite upon a biting insect

indicators.note: in a down clue, one piece sitting upon another comes before it
in a down clue, soaring means the word for the sprite is read upwards, bottom to top

parts.note: an elf is a sprite or fairy

explanation.surface: A fairy perched on a flea, like a tiny rider on a bug.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Soaring' works only because this is a down light: the sprite's letters go upwards, and 'upon' puts them above A.
explanation.definitionFit: The flea is a tiny wingless parasite that bites to feed on blood, a plain example of a biting insect.

clue.text: Protective cover started, securing line

indicators.note: securing means holding something firmly inside, so the word for started wraps round the line

parts.note: started, as a horse does in fright, means shied

explanation.surface: Someone sets about putting a protective cover in place, fastening it with a line.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Started' is a verb of sudden fright here, SHIED, not 'began'.
explanation.definitionFit: A shield is a piece of armour or a barrier carried or placed for protection, so it is a protective cover.

clue.text: Store of money unearthed (second component missing)

indicators.note: the second letter of the word for unearthed is the component left out

parts.note: something unearthed has been found

explanation.surface: A buried hoard of cash is dug up, though one part of it has gone.
explanation.walkthrough: The bracket is not an aside: it removes the O, the second letter, from FOUND.
explanation.definitionFit: A fund is a sum of money saved or set aside for a purpose, so a reserve or store of cash.

clue.text: Distribution of this marine creature could be chore in Med

indicators.note: distribution means spreading out and rearranging, so the letters of the last three words are redistributed

explanation.surface: Where a sea animal lives might be described as a household chore in the Mediterranean.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Distribution of this ... could be' says the answer's letters, rearranged, could spell 'chore in Med'; 'this' points at the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Echinoderms are the phylum of sea animals including starfish and sea urchins, all living in the sea.

clue.text: 24/7, and definitely not 9-to-5

definitions.meaning: twenty-four hours a day, seven days a week, i.e. without stopping
not keeping ordinary office hours but working all day and night

explanation.surface: Someone describes their job as constant, certainly not ordinary office hours.
explanation.walkthrough: '24/7' also names the lights 24 and 7 in the grid, but here it is the plain phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes continuous activity throughout the whole day and night, the opposite of a fixed working day.

clue.text: Minimal coverage? Heavens — little special about politician getting elected

indicators.note: about means going round, so the heavens and the small S surround the politician and elected

parts.note: the heavens are the skies
MP, Member of Parliament, is a politician
someone elected is in office
a little special is its abbreviation S

explanation.surface: An exclamation of surprise at a special skimpy outfit worn by a politician who has just won a seat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heavens' looks like an exclamation but gives SKIES; SKIES + S goes 'about' MP + IN.
explanation.definitionFit: Skimpiness is the quality of being scanty, as in a scanty garment, so a cheeky question-marked definition of minimal coverage.

clue.text: See 24
Herb is coming up — tree conceals one

indicators.note: in a down clue, coming up means read from the bottom upwards
the tree conceals the letter for one, keeping it out of sight so it no longer appears

parts.note: the maple is a tree
A, the indefinite article, means one

explanation.surface: A herb is sprouting, and a tree is hiding it from view.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Coming up' turns IS to SI; MAPLE 'conceals' A, so it drops out, leaving MPLE.
explanation.definitionFit: Simple is an old word for a medicinal plant or the remedy made from it, a crossword-friendly sense of herb.

clue.text: See 5
Market regularly failing brand

indicators.note: letters at regular intervals, every third one, fail and drop out of the word

explanation.surface: A market that keeps failing a particular brand of goods.
explanation.walkthrough: Every third letter of MARKET, the R and T, is removed.
explanation.definitionFit: A make is the brand or manufacturer of a product, as in asking what make a car is.

clue.text: Website requirement — most important, contributing to party reputation

indicators.note: contributing to means being put into the middle of the other pieces

parts.note: a do is a party
a good name is a reputation
main means chief or most important

explanation.surface: Something essential helping to build a party's good reputation.
explanation.definitionFit: Every website needs a registered address such as example.com, and that address is its domain name.

clue.text: Theatre of war where activity was uncovered?

definitions.text: Theatre of war where activity was uncovered?

parts.words: Theatre of war where activity was uncovered?
parts.note: 'theatre of war' suggests a battlefield, but it means a London theatre during the Second World War whose shows featured nude, uncovered performers

explanation.surface: A battlefield where a secret operation was discovered.
explanation.walkthrough: The Windmill Theatre in London's Soho stayed open through the Blitz with its nude tableaux, hence 'uncovered'.
explanation.definitionFit: The Windmill was a real London theatre famous for wartime revues featuring unclothed performers.

clue.text: Imaginary meeting oil-painted badly

indicators.note: something done badly is botched, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: A meeting that only happens in a poorly made oil painting.
explanation.walkthrough: In geometry, parallel lines are said to meet at a point at infinity, an imaginary meeting place.
explanation.definitionFit: In projective geometry an ideal point is the notional spot where parallel lines converge, so an imagined meeting.

clue.text: Setter's way: touch of trickery in cunning (making a boast)

parts.note: the setter says I'm, I am, of themselves
a mode is a way or manner

indicators.note: in means placed inside, so the first letter of trickery goes within the word for cunning

parts.note: sly means cunning

indicators.note: a touch of something is just a little of it, here its first letter

explanation.surface: The crossword setter's method involves sly tricks, and they boast about it.
explanation.walkthrough: IM + MODE + S(T)LY, with T from 'touch of trickery'.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting immodestly means behaving without modesty, such as bragging, so doing something while making a boast.

clue.text: Squad not favoured to take on attack

parts.note: something out is out of favour or not fashionable
a fit is a sudden attack, as of coughing

explanation.surface: An underdog team is to take on its opponents in an attack.
explanation.definitionFit: An outfit is an informal word for a group, team or organisation, much like a squad.

clue.text: Italian city — composer getting endless Latin love there

parts.note: Alban Berg was an Austrian composer

indicators.note: endless means the last letter is removed

parts.note: amor is the Latin for love

explanation.surface: A composer finding romance in an Italian city.
explanation.definitionFit: Bergamo is a city in Lombardy in northern Italy, with a famous hilltop old town.

clue.text: Gossip over rigged votes is a source of heat

indicators.note: in a down clue, one piece over another is written above it, so first

parts.note: to gas is to chatter or gossip

indicators.note: a rigged vote has been tampered with, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Talk about a fixed election becomes a heated topic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rigged' rearranges VOTES into STOVE.
explanation.definitionFit: A gas stove burns gas for cooking or warmth, so it is one kind of source of heat.

clue.text: 24/7, as claimed by the 12?

definitions.meaning: round the clock, all day every day, without a break
the boast of the London theatre at 12 across, which kept performing through the Blitz

explanation.surface: A statement of constant service, as a certain theatre boasted.
explanation.walkthrough: The Windmill Theatre's famous wartime slogan; it stayed open through the London Blitz.
explanation.definitionFit: A business that never shuts is open all the time, and the Windmill used this motto for its wartime record.

clue.text: Skilful, missing nothing about heading off fleet at sea

indicators.note: about means going round, so the shortened word surrounds the letter
missing means the letter for nothing is lost from the word

parts.note: adroit means skilful
O, the round figure zero, means nothing

indicators.note: the heading of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A skilled captain who has lost everything sets out to sea ahead of the fleet.
explanation.walkthrough: ADROIT 'missing' O gives ADRIT, which goes 'about' F.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone or something adrift is drifting without control or direction, or figuratively confused, both senses of at sea.

clue.text: See 18
Greedily eat stew of mole in bowl

indicators.note: in means placed inside, so the stirred-up letters go into the bowl

parts.note: a dish is a bowl

indicators.note: a stew is a mixture cooked together, so the letters are mixed

explanation.surface: Someone wolfs down a stew of mole served in a bowl.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stew of' mixes MOLE into EMOL, which goes 'in' DISH.
explanation.definitionFit: To demolish food is an informal idiom for eating it up quickly and completely.

clue.text: Brilliance is what's tempting about stone

indicators.note: about means going round, so the tempting word surrounds the stone abbreviation

parts.note: a lure is what tempts
ST is the abbreviation for stone, the British weight

explanation.surface: A dazzling gem is what makes a stone so tempting.
explanation.walkthrough: ST is stone, the British weight of 14 pounds.
explanation.definitionFit: Lustre is the shine or gleam of a surface, and figuratively glory, so it means brilliance.

clue.text: Loudly in favour — is most energised after intervention by Independent

parts.note: for means in favour of

indicators.note: the letter for Independent intervenes, stepping into the middle of the rearranged letters
energised means stirred into action, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone loudly backs an Independent's lively intervention.
explanation.walkthrough: 'energised' rearranges IS MOST to TISSMO; I 'intervenes' to give TISSIMO.
explanation.definitionFit: Fortissimo is the musical term for playing very loudly, so it serves as an adverb meaning loudly.

parts.note: the clue's own number pair, 24 and 7, names its two lights, while 24/7 also means all day every day

explanation.walkthrough: Also the title of a British TV sitcom set in a corner shop that never seemed to shut.
explanation.definitionFit: A shop trading at every hour of day and night is available continuously, the meaning of 24/7.

clue.text: Certain French Police will release alien

indicators.note: release means letting go, so these letters are freed and removed

parts.note: the Surete is the French detective police force
ET is the film alien, the Extra-Terrestrial

explanation.surface: The French police are sure to free a captured alien.
explanation.walkthrough: SURETE (the Sûreté) loses ET.
explanation.definitionFit: Being sure means being confident and without doubt, the same as being certain.

clue.text: No opening in crowd to hurry

indicators.note: no opening means the word's first letter is removed

parts.note: a crush is a dense crowd

explanation.surface: There's no gap in the crowd for anyone to hurry through.
explanation.definitionFit: To rush is to move or act with great haste, a direct synonym of hurry.

clue.text: New number — one released in cover

indicators.note: released means let go, so the letter for one is removed from the cover

parts.note: a veil is a cover
I, the Roman numeral, is one

explanation.surface: A new number, a song released inside a cover sleeve.
explanation.definitionFit: Novel as an adjective means new and original, unlike anything before.

clue.text: The gold is beside the end of escarpment, one hypothesises

parts.note: or is gold in heraldry

indicators.note: the end of a word is its last letter

explanation.surface: Gold lies next to the foot of a cliff, someone guesses.
explanation.walkthrough: OR is heraldic gold.
explanation.definitionFit: A theorist is a person who forms theories, someone who proposes hypotheses.
